Element validations: Full name - text, required (ASK: confirm), no default; Mobile - text, required (ASK: confirm); Email - text, optional
Functional validations: POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers with X-Tenant-ID: TAGAYTAY and X-User-ID: Steve-8414 returns 201 with taxpayer_id
